claims: University of Southern California (USC) is a private research university in Los Angeles.
U.S. News & World Report ranks USC #28 in the 2026 National Universities ranking.
The 2025-2026 application cycle for USC saw over 83,500 applications.
USC's admission rate for the 2025-2026 application cycle is around 10.4%–11.2%.
The middle 50% of admitted students at USC have an unweighted GPA between 3.79 and 4.00.
USC operates on a test-optional policy.
USC accepts the Common Application.
Over 20,000 undergraduates are enrolled at USC.
USC has a 8:1 student-faculty ratio.
USC has the School of Cinematic Arts.
USC has the Marshall School of Business.
USC has the Viterbi School of Engineering.
USC has architecture among its programs.
USC offers 150+ major choices.
USC's alumni network is called the "Trojan Family".
Business Administration, Computer Science, Communication, Cinematic Arts, and Biological Sciences are among the most popular majors at USC.
Tuition and fees at USC are approximately $75,162 per year.
About 41% of freshmen at USC receive need-based aid.
USC's main University Park campus is located in the heart of Los Angeles.
USC is a member of the Big Ten Conference.
USC competes as the USC Trojans.
USC is involved in a new statewide Brain Health Network.
